body: Fact (Opus2, 2026-11-18, from Sol-license #673 on 2C14 7e98a730): in TermAl, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` only formats Cargo-discovered modules and SKIPS files pulled in with include!() (src/main.rs includes many, e.g. src/engram_unadmitted_closing.rs). A syntax error in such a file passes fmt --check and only shows at compile. So a clean fmt check is not a parse check for included files: before READY, authors should run `cargo check --bin termal --tests` (or rustfmt --check on each changed .rs file directly), and the integration owner's freeze check should not treat fmt as covering included files.
